title: Reduce GLP-1 Side Effects
hook: Here's why you should start Zepbound at 1 milligram to avoid the side effects.
body:
For most of you watching this channel, you should be taking less than the standard 2.5 milligram minimum dose. I have found that a dose as small as 1 milligram can be beneficial for people who are already in excellent shape. Start at 1 milligram, then step up to 2, and then to 2.5. That gradual ramp avoids nearly all of the side effects that come from stepping up your dose: the nausea, the fatigue, the days where you feel like garbage. Most of that is the jump, not the drug. Once you've lost the weight, you can dial it down to maintain. I'm currently taking 1.5 milligrams a week, and that's a great long-term maintenance dose for me.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
close: Leave a comment to let me know if you've had side effects on Zepbound and what dose you started at.
